context.description: React Flow canvas setup with Zustand + Dexie persistence

finding.query: React Flow TypeScript types node edge
React Flow viewport pan zoom control

pattern.name: zustand-persist-canvas
pattern.description: Canvas state management follows the Zustand + Dexie pattern established in Epic 2 (Story 2.1) for conversation persistence. Canvas state is persisted to IndexedDB with auto-save on changes (500ms debounce).

pattern.name: two-engine-canvas
pattern.description: Two-Engine Architecture: Desktop = full editing, Mobile = read-only view. Uses useResponsive hook from Epic 1.1 for device detection.

technical_notes.note: React Flow v12 uses @xyflow/react package (renamed from reactflow). Import from '@xyflow/react' not 'reactflow'.
Lazy load React Flow to optimize bundle size: const ReactFlow = lazy(() => import('@xyflow/react'));
Use useCallback for onNodesChange, onEdgesChange, onConnect to prevent unnecessary re-renders (critical for 60fps target).
Only render visible elements with onlyRenderVisibleElements prop for large canvases (performance optimization).
Keyboard shortcuts: Arrow keys (pan), +/- (zoom), Home (fit view). Implement using useOnViewportChange hook.

file_structure.directory: - Canvas.tsx (Main canvas component) - EmptyState.tsx (Empty state component with i18n) - CanvasControls.tsx (Custom controls if needed)

test_requirements.test: - Node state management - Edge state management - Viewport state management - Persistence to Dexie - Debounced auto-save
- React Flow rendering - Pan/zoom interactions - Mobile read-only mode - Empty state display - Keyboard navigation
- State restoration on page load - Cross-tab sync (optional)
